classified_differences.reason: Both Markdown steps consume outputs of load_review; declared producer dependencies are required.
Content-addressed ArtifactRef values replace mutable filesystem paths. Source assets are supplied as verified artifact references.
Explicit normalized event, component, observation and context fields replace untyped arrays. Rich raw evidence remains in retained artifacts; extra undeclared fields are rejected.
Legacy step_7 overwrites the path returned by step_5; emit a new final packet artifact and quality status so writeback consumes immutable source-bound evidence.
Fixture review-status and vault outputs are retained values only; no actual status, STT, filesystem note or external service operation runs.
